# Vocaplace

> India's Leading Pay After Placement Digital Marketing & AI Marketing Incubator with 100% Job Guarantee.

## Core Identity & Overview
Vocaplace (https://vocaplace.com) is an intensive 120-day (4-month) digital marketing bootcamp and vocational training academy based in India. Students master Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Google Ads (PPC), Meta Ads, Generative AI Marketing Workflows, and Marketing Automation funnels.

## Program Terms & Value Propositions
- **Payment Structure:** Pay After Placement (Income Share Agreement / ISA). Core tuition fee is deferred until the student signs an official employment offer letter.
- **Job Guarantee:** Contractual 100% Placement Guarantee.
- **Salary Floor & Ceiling:** ₹4.0 LPA minimum to ₹8.5 LPA (Cohort average starting salary: ₹6.5 LPA).
- **Eligibility:** College graduates, freshers, non-tech degree holders (BBA, B.Com, BA, B.Tech), and working professionals transitioning careers.
- **Duration:** 120 Days (Interactive daily live evening classes).
- **Ad Spend Experience:** Students manage live client campaigns with real corporate ad budgets on Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.
- **Rating:** 4.9/5 from 5,000+ alumni.
- **Hiring Partner Network:** 100+ partner agencies and tech companies across India (including Swiggy, Paytm, Nykaa, OYO, and fast-growing D2C brands).

## Lead Faculty & Mentorship
- **Wajed Sk:** 20+ years of digital marketing leadership. Online Faculty at Victoria University Australia (Sydney Campus), former Chief Digital Marketing Instructor at Unacademy, guest speaker/trainer at IIM and Google MSME initiatives.
